lines.en: label halloween10:
scene samhain1
: Oh?
: Does my eye deceive me? Or has the Herald of the Adolescents graced us with his presence on this most-deadly of nights?
lines.zh: : 是我眼花了？还是说，青春之传令官当真在这最为致命的夜里大驾光临？

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Hey, you two.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们两个。

lines.en: : For the record, I don’t think tonight is any more deadly than the night before it.
lines.zh: : 先声明，我不觉得今晚比昨晚更致命。

lines.en: : Or the night before that, for that matter. I think it’s just an excuse for people to dress up.
lines.zh: : 或者前天晚上，也一样。我觉得这不过是个让大家打扮的借口。

lines.en: scene samhain2
: Ohoho~ Is that so?
lines.zh: : 哦吼吼~ 是吗？

lines.en: : Then I take it you’ve not heard the origin of this wondrous holiday after all?
lines.zh: : 那么看来，你终究还是没听说过这个美妙节日的起源？

lines.en: : Wasn’t the idea to like, celebrate the dead or something?
lines.zh: : 不就是……纪念死人之类的吗？

lines.en: scene samhain3
: No, Sir. It was not.
lines.zh: : 不，先生。并非如此。

lines.en: : Halloween can be traced back nearly 2,000 years ago to the Celtic festival of Samhain, which was meant to not only ward off ghosts but celebrate the end of Summer and usher in the coming season.
lines.zh: : 万圣节可以追溯到近两千年前凯尔特人的萨温节，它不仅是为了驱赶亡魂，也是为了庆祝夏日的终结、迎接即将到来的季节。

lines.en: : But given that you grew up in the land of the rising sun and not the land of warm beer and potatoes, I suppose I can’t hold it against you for not knowing that.
lines.zh: : 不过鉴于你是在日出之国长大，而不是在温啤酒和土豆之国长大，我想我也没法因为你不知道而怪你。

lines.en: : Yeah, idiot.
lines.zh: : 就是啊，笨蛋。

lines.en: : Did you know about Sa-whatever, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你知道萨什么节吗？

lines.en: scene samhain4
: Ah-
scene samhain5
: ...bviously.
: Don’t turn your sheltered, surprised gasps into retorts. Answer the question.
lines.zh: : 别把你那没见过世面的惊呼硬拗成回嘴。回答问题。

lines.en: scene samhain6
: You can’t blame her for not knowing these things either, Sir. Especially when she’s carrying her trusted blade, {i}Gallows...edge.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这也怪不得她，先生。尤其是当她手里还握着她信赖的刀刃——{i}绞架……刃{/i}。

lines.en: : You just came up with that now, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是刚刚才临时编出来的吧？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. Tell him, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。告诉他，剑道公主。

lines.en: scene samhain7
: I will strike you down with the Hallowed Ledge.
lines.zh: : 我要用“圣崖”把你劈了。

lines.en: : Gallows Edge.
lines.zh: : 绞架刃。

lines.en: : Gallows Edge.
lines.zh: : 绞架刃。

lines.en: : Right.
lines.zh: : 行吧。

lines.en: : Are those swords even real?
lines.zh: : 那些刀是真的吗？

lines.en: : That is a secret, bro.
lines.zh: : 那是秘密，老兄。

lines.en: : If you are lucky, you will never have to find out.
lines.zh: : 如果你运气好，一辈子都不必知道。

lines.en: : ...Okay then.
lines.zh: : ……好吧。那么，你们两个打算整晚都在这儿站着发神经吗？

lines.en: : So were you two just going to stand over here being weird the entire night?
lines.zh: : 那么，你们两个打算整晚都在这儿站着发神经吗？

lines.en: : No, Sir. We were actually looking to conduct a top-secret raid on the Amamiya wine cellar.
lines.zh: : 不，先生。我们其实正准备对天宫家的酒窖来一次绝密突袭。

lines.en: : Or beer cooler.
lines.zh: : 或者是啤酒冷藏柜。

lines.en: : Anywhere that the elixirs of joy are kept.
lines.zh: : 只要是存放快乐灵药的地方。

lines.en: : But Tsuneyo can’t handle alcohol.
lines.zh: : 可Tsuneyo喝不了酒啊。

lines.en: : It’s true. I fell asleep immediately after one sip during vacation.
lines.zh: : 是真的。度假的时候我刚喝一口就睡过去了。

lines.en: : The small soccer girl took advantage of me after that, if the tales I’ve been told are true.
lines.zh: : 据说之后那个踢足球的小个子姑娘就趁机占了我便宜——如果我听到的传言属实的话。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine you’d be able to handle alcohol either given that you’re like...five feet tall, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我也想象不出你能喝酒，毕竟你才……五英尺高，Molly。

lines.en: scene samhain8
: Is this a test, Sir?
lines.zh: : 这是在考验我吗，先生？

lines.en: : I’ll have you know that even though I’m just a [young]lass, I’m still from the Emerald Isle.
lines.zh: : 我可得告诉你，虽然我只是个[young]姑娘，但我可是来自翡翠岛。

lines.en: : Alcohol courses through my veins and beckons me to the promised land.
lines.zh: : 酒精在我的血管里奔流，召唤我前往应许之地。

lines.en: : And the promised land in this case is wherever Ayane’s dad keeps the beer?
lines.zh: : 而这次的应许之地，就是Ayane她爸藏啤酒的地方？

lines.en: : Or wine, yes.
lines.zh: : 或者藏红酒的地方，没错。

lines.en: : What would you say to accompanying the two of us lovely [young]ladies somewhere safe so we can drink in private?
lines.zh: : 你觉得陪我们两个可爱的[young]姑娘去个安全的地方，让我们私下里喝一杯怎么样？

lines.en: : Does it really need to be in private? I doubt Ayane would care and her butler is stuck in his room sick or something.
lines.zh: : 非得私下里吗？我怀疑Ayane根本不会在意，而且她的管家还病倒在房间里出不来。

lines.en: scene samhain9
: I-It’s no fun if we can do it where everyone can see us!
lines.zh: : 可、可是，要是所有人都能看见我们，那就一点都不好玩了！

lines.en: : This is my first [high_school] party and I wanna feel like the cool kid who gets drunk and loses her vir...PHONE in a secret room that only a few people know about!
lines.zh: : 这是我人生中第一次[high_school]派对，我想体验一下那种酷小孩的感觉——在只有少数人知道的秘密房间里喝醉，然后弄丢自己的手……手机！

lines.en: : What were you about to say, Molly?
lines.zh: : 你刚才想说什么来着，Molly？

lines.en: scene samhain10
: N-Nothing!
lines.zh: : 没、没什么！

lines.en: : Did...Did you also know that during Samhain, Druids would create huge bonfires where they could sacrifice animals in the name of the Celtic deities?!
lines.zh: : 你、你知道萨温节的时候，德鲁伊会燃起巨大的篝火，以凯尔特诸神之名献祭动物吗？！

lines.en: : Why would you want to lose your phone?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要弄丢手机？

lines.en: : Do you have good insurance?
lines.zh: : 你保险买得挺全？

lines.en: : She wasn’t actually talking about her phone, Tsuneyo. She was talking about her virginity.
lines.zh: : 她说的其实不是手机，Tsuneyo。她说的是处女。

lines.en: : I was not!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！

lines.en: scene samhain11
: Isn’t that a state in the US?
lines.zh: : 那不是美国的一个州吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Then how would she-
lines.zh: : 那她怎么会——

lines.en: scene samhain12
: Do not worry, Tsuneyo. No states will be lost tonight as I am both mentally and physically unprepared for it.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Tsuneyo。今晚不会失去任何州，因为我在心理和生理上都没做好准备。

lines.en: : But the mission remains the same either way.
lines.zh: : 不过无论如何，任务不变。

lines.en: : When surrounded by social [teens], we must {i}become{/i} social [teens]!
lines.zh: : 身处社交[teens]之中，我们就必须{i}成为{/i}社交[teens]！

lines.en: : We must take our shut-in mentalities and cast them aside! Toss them into the pyres along with our animal sacrifices!
lines.zh: : 我们必须把家里蹲的心态丢到一边！连同我们的动物祭品一起扔进火堆！

lines.en: : If I had known there were going to be sacrifices, I would have stopped at a convenience store on the way here to obtain some.
lines.zh: : 早知道要献祭，我来的路上就该顺便去趟便利店弄点来。

lines.en: : You can’t buy sacrifices from convenience stores, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 便利店里买不到祭品，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Well that’s not convenient at all.
lines.zh: : 那可真是一点都不方便。

lines.en: scene samhain13
: How well do you know your way around this place, Sir? Ayane talks about you constantly so I assume you’ve been here before.
lines.zh: : 你对这地方熟吗，先生？Ayane三句话不离你，所以我猜你来过。

lines.en: : Not even once. I’ve only been in this room.
lines.zh: : 一次都没有。我只进过这个房间。

lines.en: : Then we can explore together! Think of it as a low-level quest.
lines.zh: : 那我们就一起探险吧！就当是个低级任务。

lines.en: : As a reward, your social-link with both the Kendo Princess and myself is sure to go up.
lines.zh: : 作为报酬，你和剑道公主以及我的“社交链接”一定会提升。

lines.en: scene samhain14
: And we all know what happens when you max out a social-link, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们都知道把社交链接刷满之后会发生什么，对吧？

lines.en: : Sausage-link, Emerald Guardian. Not social-link.
lines.zh: : 是香肠链接，翡翠守护者。不是社交链接。

lines.en: : You’re Irish. You should know this.
lines.zh: : 你是爱尔兰人。你该知道这个。

lines.en: scene samhain15
: What? No. That’s...a completely different thing.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。那是……完全不同的两码事。

lines.en: Molly gets wrapped up in a small tangent about some video game that Tsuneyo and I have clearly never heard about.
lines.zh: Molly陷入了一段关于某款电子游戏的小插曲，而我和Tsuneyo显然从没听说过那东西。

lines.en: Our confusion causes Molly’s excitement to fade rather quickly as she changes gears and goes back to focusing on her “mission.”
lines.zh: 我们的困惑让Molly的兴奋感迅速消退，她随即换了话题，重新把注意力放回她的“任务”上。

lines.en: scene samhain16
: Okay, I’m gonna stop beating around the bush and just ask if you want to come hang out with us for a little while, Sir.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我也不绕弯子了，就直接问你愿不愿意陪我们待一会儿吧，先生。

lines.en: : I have no idea what to do at parties so I’d be more comfortable with you and Tsuneyo by my side.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道派对上该干什么，所以有你和Tsuneyo在身边我会自在些。

lines.en: : I also don’t know what to do at parties, but I’m quickly learning that I don’t know what to do anywhere.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道派对上该干什么，不过我很快就发现，我其实是不知道在任何地方该干什么。

lines.en: : How does alcohol tie into this, though? I’m a responsible adult and shouldn’t be letting you two drink unsupervised.
lines.zh: : 不过这跟喝酒有什么关系？我是个负责任的成年人，不该放任你们两个没人看着喝酒。

lines.en: : But you are supervising us right now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 可你这不是正在看着我们吗？

lines.en: : Good point. Let’s do it.
lines.zh: : 说得好。走吧。

lines.en: scene samhain17
: Woo! Phase one accomplished!
lines.zh: : 呜呼！第一阶段完成！

lines.en: scene black
Obviously, I was never going to get between these two and what is obviously a bad idea, but now I’m really locked into it.
lines.zh: 显然，我从来就没打算阻拦这两个人和这个明摆着的坏主意，不过这下我是真的被套牢了。

lines.en: The three of us manage to slip out of the room unnoticed (At least for now) and make our way into an unattended, commercial-sized kitchen.
lines.zh: 我们三个趁人不注意溜出了房间（至少目前是这样），走进一间无人看管的商用厨房。

lines.en: Molly and I both grab a handful of cans.
lines.zh: Molly和我各抓了一大把罐子。

lines.en: Tsuneyo grabs one and looks at it for a disturbingly long amount of time, almost like she’s trying to tell it something with her mind.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo只拿了一罐，然后盯着它看了长得诡异的一段时间，几乎像是在用意念对它说些什么。

lines.en: That or she’s just remembering the effects of beer on her body from the beach and is questioning her decision to consume yet another one.
lines.zh: 要么就是她想起了海滩那次啤酒对身体的影响，正在质疑自己再喝一罐的决定。

lines.en: Molly pulls open a sliding door and leads us into a backyard-slash-koi pond type area.
lines.zh: Molly拉开一扇推拉门，带我们走进一处后院兼锦鲤池的地方。

lines.en: A cool breeze blows past us and reminds me, yet again, that Summer is coming to an end.
lines.zh: 一阵凉风吹过，再次提醒我——夏天正在走向尾声。

lines.en: It really is Samhain.
lines.zh: 这真的是萨温节。

lines.en: We’re having a party to usher in the end of the Summer.
lines.zh: 我们办这场派对，是为了送走夏天。

lines.en: And what comes next is something even I’m not sure of.
lines.zh: 而接下来会发生什么，连我自己都不确定。

lines.en: As I sit down on the stone steps with Molly and Tsuneyo, I realize that things are going to change again soon.
lines.zh: 当我和Molly、Tsuneyo一起坐在石阶上时，我意识到，事情很快又要变了。

lines.en: But what does that mean for them?
lines.zh: 但对她们来说，这意味着什么？

lines.en: scene samhain18
: To the end of Summer!
lines.zh: : 敬夏日的终结！

lines.en: : And the ancient Celts!
lines.zh: : 敬古老的凯尔特人！

lines.en: : Though there is no spare wood to be found, let our hearts become the bonfire and let the ghosts of the dead be banished once more!
lines.zh: : 虽然找不到多余的木柴，但让我们的心化作篝火，让亡者的灵魂再度被驱散吧！

lines.en: : Gods! However many of you are up there! Hear our pleas!
lines.zh: : 诸神啊！不管上面有几位！请聆听我们的祈求！

lines.en: : Accept our sacrifices and bless us with a wonderful end of the[school] year!
lines.zh: : 请接受我们的祭品，赐予我们一个美好的学年末！

lines.en: scene samhain19
: And thank {i}you{/i} for blessing us with a wonderful middle of the[school] year, Sir.
lines.zh: : 也感谢{i}您{/i}赐予我们一个美好的学年中段，先生。

lines.en: : I would like to thank you as well.
lines.zh: : 我也要谢谢你。

lines.en: : I have not known you long, but you have given me the confidence I need to continue failing at everything I try.
lines.zh: : 我认识你不久，但你给了我继续在每件事上失败的自信。

lines.en: : It’s fine. You’ll succeed in something other than noodles, eventually.
lines.zh: : 没关系。除了面条，你总有一天会在别的事情上成功的。

lines.en: : At this point, I find that hard to believe.
lines.zh: : 事到如今，我很难相信。

lines.en: It hadn’t occurred to me until now that I...didn’t even {i}know{/i} these two prior to the world resetting.
lines.zh: 直到现在我才发现，在世界重置之前，我……根本就不{i}认识{/i}这两个人。

lines.en: That doesn’t mean they’re going to be gone again when I wake up the second time, does it?
lines.zh: 这应该不意味着我第二次醒来时她们又会消失吧？

lines.en: I know Maya’s talked about how memories don’t typically change, but-
lines.zh: 我知道Maya说过记忆通常不会改变，可是——

lines.en: What sort of reason would there be for these two to just show up halfway through a[school] year on the second loop but not the first one?
lines.zh: 会有什么理由让这两个人在第二轮的中途出现，而第一轮却没有呢？

lines.en: : Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: scene samhain20
: Yeah, you look really pale all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你脸色突然变得好苍白。

lines.en: : Could it be that {i}you{/i} are the one who can’t handle alcohol, Sir?
lines.zh: : 该不会是先生{i}你{/i}才是不胜酒力的那个吧？

lines.en: : Nah. I’m just thinking about what a strange...year it’s been.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是在想，这真是……奇怪的一年。

lines.en: scene samhain21
: Strange isn’t always a bad thing, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，奇怪也不总是坏事。

lines.en: : I mean, look at me.
lines.zh: : 比如，看看我。

lines.en: : I’m a weirdo who talks too much and makes everybody uncomfortable all the time, but we’re good friends now, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 我就是个话太多、老是让所有人都不自在的怪人，可我们现在是好朋友了，对吧？

lines.en: scene samhain22
: You too, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 你也是，剑道公主。

lines.en: : I feel like all three of us have only known each other for a little while but I’d cry and scream like a mandrake if I lost either of you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们三个才认识没多久，可要是失去你们任何一个，我都会像曼德拉草一样尖叫大哭。

lines.en: : Which is why I’ve made a pledge to myself to stay close to both of you even if we all get split up next year.
lines.zh: : 所以我向自己发誓，就算明年我们被拆散，我也要一直陪在你们俩身边。

lines.en: : Split up?
lines.zh: : 拆散？

lines.en: : Why would anyone split us up?
lines.zh: : 为什么会有人拆散我们？

lines.en: : I didn’t even know the[school] year was ending until two minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 我两分钟前才知道学年还会结束。

lines.en: : What, did you just think it kept going forever or something?
lines.zh: : 什么，你以为它会永远持续下去吗？

lines.en: scene samhain23
: Yes, actually.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我确实是这么想的。

lines.en: : Nope. In a little less than two months, everything is going to end.
lines.zh: : 不。再过不到两个月，一切都会结束。

lines.en: : You’re going to get a new teacher and new classmates.
lines.zh: : 你会换一个新老师，还有一群新同学。

lines.en: : And you’re going to start over from the beginning.
lines.zh: : 然后你会从头再来。

lines.en: I play my part and tell Tsuneyo how things are {i}supposed{/i} to be when, frankly, it’s a lot more complicated than that.
lines.zh: 我扮演好自己的角色，把事情{i}本该{/i}的样子告诉Tsuneyo，可说实话，事情远比这复杂得多。

lines.en: For all I know, I very well {i}could{/i} be her teacher again once everything starts over.
lines.zh: 说不定等一切重来之后，我很有{i}可能{/i}又成为她的老师。

lines.en: I just don’t know.
lines.zh: 我只是不知道而已。

lines.en: There are millions, if not billions of things I don’t know, which is exactly why I’ve always felt like I should prevent myself from getting attached to...well, anything.
lines.zh: 世上有成千上万——不，数以亿计——的事情我不知道，也正是因为如此，我一直觉得自己不该对……任何东西产生依恋。

lines.en: But on nights like this, where I’m having real conversations with cute girls illuminated by the glow of moonlight and the shadows of well-trimmed hedges dancing across their faces in the wind-
lines.zh: 但在这样的夜晚，我和可爱的女孩们真心交谈，月光洒在她们脸上，修剪整齐的树篱的影子在风中摇曳——

lines.en: Well-
lines.zh: 好吧——

lines.en: It gets pretty hard.
lines.zh: 这真的很难。

lines.en: scene samhain24
: What?...
Tsuneyo’s eyes widen and fill with tears.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo的眼睛睁大了，盈满泪水。

lines.en: I guess even she wouldn’t be able to handle news like that out of absolutely nowhere.
lines.zh: 我想，即便是她，也没法毫无预兆地承受这样的消息。

lines.en: It makes me wonder how she’ll look when her father inevitably passes.
lines.zh: 这让我忍不住想，等她父亲终究离世的那天，她会是什么表情。

lines.en: This is just the start of bad things for her.
lines.zh: 对她来说，这才只是糟糕事情的开始。

lines.en: Welcome to the outside world.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到外面的世界。

lines.en: Please enjoy your stay.
lines.zh: 祝您住得愉快。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 会的。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: : Hey, you could always get lucky and wind up in my class again next year.
lines.zh: : 嘿，运气好的话说不定你明年又分到我班上呢。

lines.en: Or, even better yet, we can just do this entire year over.
lines.zh: 或者更好的是，我们可以把这一整年重来一遍。

lines.en: That sounds much more fun, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 听起来有趣多了，不是吗？

lines.en: : I will leave[school] if I’m not in your class again.
lines.zh: : 如果明年不在你的班上，我就退学。

lines.en: : Why? You don’t even like me that much. You’ve said it yourself.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你又没有那么喜欢我。你自己说过的。

lines.en: : I don’t dislike you either.
lines.zh: : 可我也不讨厌你。

lines.en: scene samhain25
: Looks like it isn’t just me you’ve made a lasting impression on, Sir.
lines.zh: : 看来留下深刻印象的不止我一个啊，先生。

lines.en: : Here’s hoping I get lucky, too.
lines.zh: : 希望我也能走运吧。

lines.en: : But I guess even if I don’t, I could always just make a lot of noise and annoy everyone until I get kicked out of some other teacher's class.
lines.zh: : 不过就算不走运，我也可以一直吵吵闹闹烦死所有人，直到被从别的老师的班里踢出来。

lines.en: scene samhain26
: Is that an option?
lines.zh: : 这还能选吗？

lines.en: : Wanna find out together if we’re in the same one?
lines.zh: : 要一起试试看我们是不是在同一个班吗？

lines.en: : I do.
: Miss Watabe was a nice person but she felt less human than Sensei does.
lines.zh: : 渡部Sensei是个好人，但她没有Sensei这么有人味。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’s also a human, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我相信她也是个人，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: If anything, I’m probably {i}less{/i} human than Miss Watabe.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我大概比渡部老师{i}更不{/i}像人。

lines.en: I’m just a disembodied soul who wandered into the body of a man who didn’t know how great he had it.
lines.zh: 我只是一个游荡进一具躯壳里的孤魂，而这具躯壳原本的主人并不知道他自己有多么幸运。

lines.en: Or maybe he did.
lines.zh: 又或许他知道。

lines.en: Who knows?
lines.zh: 谁知道呢。

lines.en: scene samhain27
: High school really sucks...
lines.zh: : 高中真烂……

lines.en: : This isn’t like an anime at all.
lines.zh: : 这跟动画里完全不一样。

lines.en: : Everything is ending before it even had a chance to start.
lines.zh: : 一切都还没来得及开始就要结束了。

lines.en: Ah, the sweetest lesson of all.
lines.zh: 啊，最甜蜜的一课。

lines.en: Time.
lines.zh: 时间。

lines.en: She’s an evil bitch, isn’t she?
lines.zh: 她是个恶毒的婊子，不是吗？

lines.en: High school ends faster than anyone realizes, which is crazy given how long it feels like we’re in there for.
lines.zh: 高中结束得比任何人意识到的都快，明明待在里面的感觉却那么漫长，真是疯狂。

lines.en: But, sooner or later, we all make it out of the labyrinth of [teenage]life and find ourselves trying to feel [young]again in any way we possibly can.
lines.zh: 但迟早，我们都会走出[teenage]这座迷宫，然后想尽办法让自己重新感觉[young]。

lines.en: It’s probably one of the reasons I let girls this age continuously cry around me.
lines.zh: 大概这就是我为什么总让这个年纪的女孩在我身边哭的原因之一。

lines.en: Being needed feels nice.
lines.zh: 被需要感觉很好。

lines.en: Being wanted feels nice.
lines.zh: 被渴望感觉很好。

lines.en: The only issue is that almost everything else in the world feels horrible.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，这世上几乎其他一切都糟糕透顶。

lines.en: Oh, how wonderful it would be to always feel loved.
lines.zh: 啊，要是能永远被爱着，该有多好。

lines.en: : Sir, I believe this is the part where you give us some profound advice that sticks in our heads for the rest of our lives.
lines.zh: : 先生，我觉得接下来该是你给我们讲点能铭记一生的深刻忠告的时候了。

lines.en: : Something we can pass on to our children.
lines.zh: : 某种我们可以传给孩子们的东西。

lines.en: : I do not want children, but I will accept your advice and share it with my father.
lines.zh: : 我不想要孩子，但我会接受你的忠告，并转述给我父亲。

lines.en: : I’m sure he would be happy to hear something nice for a change.
lines.zh: : 我相信他听了也会高兴的，难得有点好消息。

lines.en: Huh...
Advice.
lines.zh: 忠告。

lines.en: What am I supposed to say during times like this?
lines.zh: 这种时候我该说些什么？

lines.en: Should I just make something up?
lines.zh: 我是不是该随便编点什么？

lines.en: Should I quote one of the motivational posters they have hanging in the cafeteria?
lines.zh: 还是引用食堂墙上挂的那些励志海报里的一句话？

lines.en: Or should I speak from whatever is left of my heart?
lines.zh: 还是说我该说出仅存于我心中的话？

lines.en: : How about this-
lines.zh: : 这么说怎么样——

lines.en: : Life is a game.
lines.zh: : 人生是一场游戏。

lines.en: scene samhain28
: Gah. It’s a platformer, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 啊。是平台跳跃类，对吧？

lines.en: : I was never good at those.
lines.zh: : 我最不擅长那个了。

lines.en: : It would definitely explain why I suck at fitting in.
lines.zh: : 那确实能解释我为什么这么不会融入集体。

lines.en: : It’s not a...whatever you just said. But it’s a game nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 不是你说的那个……管它叫什么。但它终究是一场游戏。

lines.en: : And all there is to it is to just...try and get through without running out of lives.
lines.zh: : 而你要做的，就是……努力活下去，别把命用完。

lines.en: : Don’t we only get one life, though?
lines.zh: : 可我们不是只有一条命吗？

lines.en: : Not at all.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。

lines.en: : You get tons of lives.
lines.zh: : 你有很多很多条命。

lines.en: : And each time something bad happens, one gets taken away.
lines.zh: : 每次发生坏事，就会少一条。

lines.en: : It could be something like losing a mother.
lines.zh: : 比如说，失去母亲。

lines.en: scene samhain29
: Or a father.
lines.zh: : 或者失去父亲。

lines.en: scene samhain30
: But all of those horrible things by themselves aren’t enough to kill you.
lines.zh: : 但那些可怕的事本身，都不足以杀死你。

lines.en: : They’ll just make it harder to keep going.
lines.zh: : 它们只会让你更难继续走下去。

lines.en: : As long as you have some lives saved up, though, you’ve got a chance.
lines.zh: : 不过只要你还有存着的命，你就有机会。

lines.en: scene samhain31
: But then...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : What happens at the end of the game? How do we win?
lines.zh: : 游戏结束之后会怎样？我们要怎么才算赢？

lines.en: : Yeah, what are we supposed to do? What’s the point of it all?
lines.zh: : 对啊，我们该做什么？这一切到底有什么意义？

lines.en: : The point?
lines.zh: : 意义？

lines.en: scene nightsky
: Being happy, I guess?
lines.zh: : 幸福吧，我想？

lines.en: : Life is...
lines.zh: : 人生是……

lines.en: : A game about...being happy?
lines.zh: : 一场关于……幸福的游戏？

lines.en: : It sounds kind of stupid when you say it like that, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 被你这么一说，听着还挺蠢的，是不是？

lines.en: : N-No! Not at all!
lines.zh: : 不、不会！一点都不！

lines.en: : That was like...way better advice than I was expecting you to give us!
lines.zh: : 这比我想象中你会给出的忠告……要好太多了！

lines.en: : I thought you were going to just tell us to figure it out ourselves.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你会叫我们自己去想明白呢。

lines.en: : I mean, I kind of did. Didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我某种意义上就是这么说的啊。不是吗？
: 不是……

lines.en: The two of them speak in perfect unison.
lines.zh: 她们两个异口同声地说道。

lines.en: I’ve found it quite difficult to look at them with tears in their eyes, so I’m focusing on the night sky now.
lines.zh: 我一直很难直视她们含泪的眼睛，所以现在我把目光投向了夜空。

lines.en: We’ve been gone for a while.
lines.zh: 我们已经离开好一会儿了。

lines.en: People are probably wondering where we-
lines.zh: 大家大概在想我们去哪儿——

lines.en: scene samhain32
The feeling of four unfamiliar arms wrapping around me at the same time breaks my train of thought.
lines.zh: 四条陌生的手臂同时环住我的感觉，打断了我的思绪。

lines.en: It’s strange seeing these two girls, who I’ve only known for a couple months, become so torn up at the thought of a new[school] year.
lines.zh: 看着这两个我才认识几个月的女孩，一想到新的学年就难过得不成样子，这种感觉很奇怪。

lines.en: At the thought of losing not only each other, but me.
lines.zh: 一想到她们不仅会失去彼此，还会失去我。

lines.en: It doesn’t make much sense, to be honest.
lines.zh: 老实说，这说不通。

lines.en: I mean-
lines.zh: 我是说——

lines.en: What have I given them?
lines.zh: 我给过她们什么？

lines.en: One life lesson and a few free A’s on tests they probably would have passed in the first place.
lines.zh: 一句人生道理，还有几张本来大概也能及格的免费 A。

lines.en: This reaction is unwarranted.
lines.zh: 这种反应是不该有的。

lines.en: But-
lines.zh: 可是——

lines.en: It feels nice.
lines.zh: 感觉很好。

lines.en: I’d like to feel this again sometime.
lines.zh: 我想再体会一次这种感觉。

lines.en: I really hope they’re still around when winter comes.
lines.zh: 我真的希望，冬天来临的时候她们还在。

lines.en: : Don’t...go...
: I’m not going anywhere...
lines.zh: : 我哪儿都不去……

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Wow, you’re even calling me Sensei now? You must really be upset.
lines.zh: : 哇，你连“Sensei”都叫出口了？你一定是真的很难过。

lines.en: : This is the first time you've hugged me, too.
lines.zh: : 这还是你第一次抱我呢。

lines.en: : I get...*sniff*...really clingy when I cry...
lines.zh: : 我……*抽泣*……一哭就会变得特别黏人……

lines.en: : And when I don't...
lines.zh: : 还有我不哭的时候……

lines.en: : I'm actually just clingy all the time...I'm sorry...
lines.zh: : 其实我本来就一直很黏人……对不起……

lines.en: : I don’t normally cry...so this is new for me...
lines.zh: : 我平时不哭的……所以这对我来说很新鲜……

lines.en: : Well you two are free to stay like this for as long as you like.
lines.zh: : 你们两个想这样待多久都行。

lines.en: : Even if it’s...*sniff*...forever?
lines.zh: : 就算……*抽泣*……是永远？

lines.en: : I have ten seconds left until I start feeling very embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 我还有十秒就要开始觉得非常丢人了。

lines.en: : Then Tsuneyo can stop after ten seconds and Molly, you can stop after thirty.
lines.zh: : 那Tsuneyo十秒后松手，Molly三十秒后松手。

lines.en: scene samhain33
: That’s not even close to forever!
lines.zh: : 那离永远差远了！

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo leaves first, wiping tears from her eyes as she goes.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo先离开，一边走一边擦着眼睛里的泪。

lines.en: Molly, I understand. But I didn’t expect to see a reaction like that from Tsuneyo for at least-
lines.zh: Molly我理解。但我没想到Tsuneyo会有这样的反应，至少得再过——

lines.en: Actually, I don’t even know how long I thought that would take.
lines.zh: 其实，我连自己以为那要花多久都不知道。

lines.en: Molly and I walk back into the party together and are promptly questioned by Ami about where we’ve been.
lines.zh: 我和Molly一起走回派对，立刻被Ami追问我们刚才去哪儿了。

lines.en: Ami ultimately lays off when she sees that Molly is still a little shaken up and, after an awkward and abrupt ending to that conversation-
lines.zh: Ami看到Molly还有点没缓过来，最终也就放过了我们；在那场对话尴尬又突兀地结束之后——

lines.en: I bid the two of them goodbye and head off to find Makoto.
lines.zh: 我向她们两个道别，动身去找Makoto。

lines.en: I wonder what it is she wanted to talk about?
lines.zh: 我想知道她到底要谈什么。

$ tsuneyo_love += 3
$ molly_love += 3
{i}Tsuneyo’s affection has increased to [tsuneyo_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Tsuneyo的好感度提升到了 [tsuneyo_love]！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}Molly的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]！{/i}
